localChanges: Save Game now keeps your save in the browser instead of downloading it. Load Game lists every save kept there, newest first, with buttons to load, download or delete each one, and loading from a file is still at the bottom (closes #653).

Unless autosave is off, every new game keeps a save of its first turn, and the game autosaves every 5 turns, replacing the previous autosave, so a crash or a closed tab costs a few turns rather than the game. Options can make that every 10 or 20 turns, the first turn only, or off.
